newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine business rejects wage hike plea.
newsitem.headline: Philippine business rejects wage hike plea.

text.p: The Employers Confederation of the Philippines (ECOP) on Friday rejected demands by workers for higher wages following the recent sharp depreciation of the peso.
"Employers and businessmen are up in arms against a new round of wage increases being demanded by some segments of organised labour," ECOP said in a statement.
Citing a survey conducted among its members, ECOP said 86 percent of its members said a wage hike would make them unable to compete with other manufacturers in southeast Asia.
"It would trigger inflation and higher cost of goods and services; and it is untimely and uncalled for," the statement added.
A new round of increases in petroleum prices on Thursday is expected to intensify the clamour for an across-the-board wage hike.
